Samsung and Google Pixel Phones on Sale in India

Amazon is offering discounts on five Samsung phone models, with prices starting at ₹16,999, including foldable phones. Flipkart's Big Billion Days sale will feature discounts on Google Pixel smartphones. It is noted that Google Pixel phones are not officially sold on Amazon, and purchasing from there may void warranty.
